title: How do I import a survey?
intent: This article explains how to import a previously exported survey file into EUSurvey.
short_answer: To import a survey, navigate to the Forms page and click 'Import Survey'. Select a previously exported EUSurvey archive file (.eus format). The system imports the survey structure including all questions, translations, and configuration. The imported survey is created as a new draft.
prerequisites: A valid EUSurvey export file (.eus) must be available
procedure: A dialog appears for file selection.
Select the .eus export file from your computer.
Click Import to start the process.
The system validates and imports the survey.
The imported survey appears as a new draft in your survey list.
important_conditions: Only EUSurvey export files (.eus format) can be imported.
The imported survey is always created as a new draft.
If the file contains unsupported HTML code, the system escapes it and shows a warning.
Import may fail if the file is corrupted or was exported from an incompatible version.
Translations included in the export file are imported along with the survey structure.
troubleshooting: 'The file could not be imported' error: The file may be corrupted or in an unsupported format. Try re-exporting from the source.
'EUSurvey found unsupported HTML code' warning: The import succeeded but some HTML was escaped. Review the survey for escaped characters.
